EventChild.description: EventChild defines one entity type or object that an event can spawn.

lootmax.description: LootMax caps the amount of loot generated around this child, where the event type uses child loot limits.

lootmin.description: LootMin sets the lower loot amount generated around this child, where the event type uses child loot limits.

max.description: Max is the upper number of instances for this child type when the event's limit mode applies bounds per child.

min.description:
Min is the lower number of instances for this child type when the event's limit mode applies bounds per child.
Ambient spawners use this value as a relative weight when selecting among child types.

type.description: Type is the game class name created for this child entry.

EventChildren.description: EventChildren groups the possible entity types or objects created by an event.

child.description: Children are the spawnable entries and their per-type limits or weights.

EventDef.description: EventDef configures one dynamic event and the rules CE uses to place, populate, retain, and replenish its instances.

active.description: Active enables or disables spawning for this event (`1` or `0`).

children.description: Children define the entity classes or objects created by this event and any per-child count or loot limits.

cleanupradius.description:
CleanupRadius controls when an event zone may clean up its spawned entities.
Ambient zones remain active while a player is within this radius.

distanceradius.description:
DistanceRadius controls the distance condition for placing event instances.
For ambient zone events, it is the player distance at which a zone becomes eligible to spawn its entities.

flags.description: Flags control event cleanup and initial-spawn behavior.

lifetime.description:
Lifetime is how long an event instance may remain active before it expires, in seconds.
Entity lifetime may also be controlled by its type entry.

limit.description: Limit selects how Min and Max apply to the child entries and their combined event count.

max.description: Max is the upper event count bound used by the selected Limit mode.

min.description: Min is the lower event count bound used by the selected Limit mode.

name.description: Name is the event identifier referenced by position and group data.

nominal.description: Nominal is the target number of active instances CE tries to maintain for this event.

position.description: Position selects how CE chooses event locations, for example from fixed mission positions or from a generated distribution.

restock.description: Restock is the delay, in seconds, before CE may create a replacement event instance.

saferadius.description: SafeRadius is the minimum clearance used by CE's event placement rules.

secondary.description: Secondary names an additional event CE may spawn for each instance, such as the infected event paired with a crash site or convoy.

EventFlags.description: EventFlags controls whether CE can delete an event instance, randomizes its initial spawning, and removes damaged spawned entities.

deletable.description: Deletable allows CE to remove this event instance during cleanup.

init_random.description: InitRandom randomizes the event's initial spawn state.

remove_damaged.description: RemoveDamaged allows CE to remove damaged or ruined entities created by this event so they can be replaced.

EventsFile.description: EventsFile configures Central Economy dynamic events such as vehicle spawns, crash sites, and ambient animal zones.

event.description: Events are the dynamic event definitions processed by CE.

events.description: XMLName identifies the required `<events>` document root.
